book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Tambiy mapetok wo axeing wou Yesu
Yesu pup en Laweeng Vambuing, om loumelam anghei memiing Yorodan me Laweeng Vambuing qou e me la tembuing bandaing,
teyei lek bouk xoumeeng vey (40) eno tambiy mapetok wo axeing wou e. Moxo se ya bambou lek bouk ti beimambei yon, me lek bouk tiwei la tip lek eno maxepya e.
Om tambiy mapetok neil wou e, “Wangwei wa Anutu Neu Moux nei, ond neil wou qakous tine en e pekwi me bo belet o.”
Yesu lewexe me neil embei, “Xel byex eivek xoulek eno nambei nye: ‘Xomaxoneing tyek se mendei mapieing en belet venaxow.’”
Tambiy mapetok qou e me lek me la lukendu vaxading ti me talex tete lalei dalus wei tembuing sapa eno daing wou e.
Me neil wou e, “Tyek am bong lei ngandoung me vunekeing nimzamza ne wou wang, en inye toundei eivek a memang, me ambei bong wou xelti, ond tyek a bong wou e.
Om wangwei wang bong lalo wou ay, ond tyek wa xe lulul ne dalus.”
Yesu lewexe bei, “Xel byex eivek xoulek eno nambei nye, ‘Wang bong lalo wou Tambiy Ngandoung wa xe Anutu me na mi bong emaxow xe xuk.’”
Woyom tambiy mapetok qou e me la beyeeng Yerusalem me la lax lek xomek vambuing pundanghou nei. De neil wou e, “Wangwei wa Anutu Neu Moux nei ond wa tetoing anghei inye me ghe na xonei.
En xel byex eivek xoulek eno nambei nye,

content.text: “‘Moxo tyek baluk nikanzek wou e xe angela
en xel nam gyeiteyei wang bo nimza.
Tyek xel a zeim wang zekna nangya memend en kandek wa seng
nyeis vaxam lek qakous.’” Qapiya Lalo 91:11-12

content: Yesu lewexe bei, “Xoulek neil ambei nye, ‘Wa se toung Tambiy Ngandoung wa xe Anutu eivek axeing.’”
Gyeik ingwei tambiy mapetok wong axeing ti beimambei yon ma eno mema tena e de di axe deka bouk nge le.
Xel Nasaret pesek Yesu
Laweeng Vambuing wong nikanzek wou Yesu me e lox me la Galili de pavulek wei e eno la teyei lek tembuing danghei tiyon dalus.
Moxo mi teyoxe xoulek wou xel eivek xel xe xomek qekueing ama me moux alis vex sapa mi sanghoxe e lei.

Moxo la beyeeng Nasaret, wei wo teiv lek o, de lek bouk wei Sabat eno la eivek xomek qekueing ama wei xel xe eno lalei nambei ingwei mi wong taxombouk o. Me moxo nale ghey en embei pyaw Anutu xe xoulek.
Xel wong poropet
Yesaya xe qapiya vambuing wei xel mi vevilexe lek xax eno wou e. Tul me yeiwou senghoing tiwei qayeeng di yeip lek o:

content.text: “Tambiy Ngandoung xe Laweeng Vambuing lam dei lek ay
en nambei e taw wel lek ay me beyal ay
bei a neil Xoulek Nimza wou xel kanyo.
Moxo wong a lam bei a nam a neilteyei wou xel wei la dei eivek xomek xeitueing o bei xel bong xel nam myayaing
me na neil wou xel wei mend tekeing o bei xel mend gyeina
me na bong xel wei xomaxoneing mi wo nol wou xel eno nam myayaing veil nimaying,
de na neil vakovek qes wei Tambiy Ngandoung embei bong lulul nimza wou moux alis vex eno teyei.” Yesaya 62:1-2

content: Woyom vevilexe qapiya me wong elox wou xukxe de dei tembuing. Xel wei toundei eivek xomek qekueing ama eno dalusateiv di yei e kanzek.
Me mouk neil wou xel bei, “Gweimbeeng xoulek wei xam ghe ngo ne wo neing lek.”
Xel dalus luk nimza en e, en qayeeng nimzamza wei di neil on om xel etek me teling bei, “Beip inye se Yosep neu ei?”

Yesu neil wou xel bei, “Neing ayang tyek xam a neil qayeeng pakeing tine wou ay: ‘Dokta wamaxow ghe bong xow bo nimzalek! Wang bong lulul vatiyeiw eivek wamaxow bam qes ne, nambei vatiyeiw wei xa ngo wang wong eivek beyeeng Kapenaom o.’”
Moxo tetulexe qayeeng me neil, “A neil zonghek wou xam, xel xomaxoneing se mi lenghek lek poropet ti eivek emaxow beeng qes.

A neil neing wou xam no bei inye vexeiv ngenong toundei eivek Israel eivek bouk wei poropet Eliya yo, gyeik ingwei tyoung xey zeyi teyei lek vakovek qes yal me dentouk limti is me sewis wei maxep ngandoung yeip ela teyei lek tembuing tambak.
Ekom Anutu se wong Eliya la wou xel Israelyeiw on ti, qe wong e la wou vexeiv ti eivek beyeeng Sarepat eivek tembuing wei Saidon nei.
Me inye moux alis vex ngenong toundei eivek Israel eno vanei lepa
wong xel eivek bouk wei poropet Elisa yo, ekom xelti se wo nimzalek, qe Naimang wei Siria nei venaxow.”
Xomaxoneing dalus wei toundei eivek xomek qekueing ama eno laleind wo vanei ngandoung gyeik ingwei xel ngo qayeeng tiyon o.
Xel qandi lek, me tiy e la myayaing veil beyeeng wei xel ev lek qetyei. Om xel qou e me la lek bembembek wei lukendu yon en embei tendu e doing.
Ekom dembu me la senghoing eivek moux alis vex ngenongakes on de la.
Yesu tiy laweeng nilaxes la myayaing
Woyom moxo lep me la xo Kapenaom nei, beyeeng on toundei eivek distrik Galili, de lek bouk wei Sabat eno mi teyoxe xomaxoneing.
Xel etek en e xe qayeeng wei teyoxe yo, en e xe qayeeng on lam is nikanzek ngandoung.
Eivek xomek qekueing ama eno tambiy ti memo laweeng nilaxes mindei eivek e. Moxo eng ngandoungateiv me neil,
“E! Wa being bong vati wou xa, Yesu wei Nasaret o? Wang lam en wa being nam bo nol wou xa? A woulek wang woy bei wa Tambiy Vambuing tiwei Anutu xe yo!”
Om Yesu luk niseikeing wou e me neil, “Denduing ma! De lam myayaing veil moux tiyon!” Om memo yon nex tambiy on la lek tembuing wou xel mend de lam myayaing veil e dom se wo nol wou no.
Xomaxoneing on dalus etek me di neil wouma bei, “Teyoxeing qayeeng tine vati? Om lam is lei ngandoung me nikanzek de luk nikanzek wou laweeng nilaxes me xel lam myayaing!”
Me e xe pavulek wei wong vatiyeiw eno la teyei lek tembuing tiyon dalus.
Yesu wong Simon yeing wo nimzalek
Yesu la veil xomek qekueing ama me la eivek Simon beeng. Gying ngandoung wo nol wou Simon yeing avexta, me gweimbeeng xel teling wou Yesu bei e devind vexo.
Om la paviy vexo me luk niseikeing wou gying, me ema veil e. Vexo qandi lek lutika me la menyex wou lul yaeing wou xel.
Yesu wong moux alis vex ngenong wo nimzalek
Gyeik ingwei sayeiv teila eno xomaxoneing qou xel dalus wei vanei nelu nelu wong xel o me la wou Yesu me e liw mema lek xel titi, moxo wong xel dalus wo nimzalek.
Xel memo ngenongakes lam myayaing veil xomaxoneing ngenong me di taxe bei, “Wang on Anutu Neu Moux!” Ekom moxo luk nikanzek wou xel me peti xel, en nambei xel woulek bei e Kilisi.
Yesu ghavineeng eivek beyeeng valu
Satiboukeing lul eno Yesu qandi me la ingwei xel ma veil o. Om xomaxoneing mi yimexe e, gyeik ingwei xel la yeiwou e eno xel wong en xel embei neil axound e bei e se na veil xel.
Ekom neil embei, “A na neil Xoulek Nimza wei tete lalei wei Anutu yo, wou xel beyeeng bamba nei is, en qes tiyon om wong a lam.”
Me moxo la neil xoulek lala eivek xomek qekueing ama dalus wei Yudia nei.

footnotes.text: poropet: tambiy wei mi neil Anutu xe xoulek o.
Lepa: Vanei nol wei mi wong xel ninavi mi mey o.
Kilisi. Eivek qayeeng wei Hibru eno xel neil, Mesia. Qes, tambiy wei Anutu beyal bei e qou xomaxoneing noum o.
